manualInstaller.method: Windows Computer Use @oai/sky; no silent-install switches
manualInstaller.scopeCaveat: The installer identified an existing per-user registration, so this is a visible reinstall/upgrade wizard, not proof of a registry-clean first installation.

manualUninstaller.performedBy: user; completion explicitly confirmed in chat
manualUninstaller.automationLimitation: Windows Computer Use refused to launch the uninstaller with product policy blocks this app. No alternate UI automation or silent uninstall was used to bypass that restriction.
manualUninstaller.sourceReview: The stock electron-builder NSIS template contains registry deletion at the end of the uninstall section. Data retention configuration does not intentionally retain installation registration. The exact uninstaller process and its exit result were not captured, so no production workaround was added.
manualUninstaller.furtherDiagnosis: Capture the actual registered uninstall command, matching executable hash and completed process outcome before reinstalling; verify both per-user installation and uninstall keys are gone.

installedRuntimeRecheck.harnessRecovery: An initial background-hidden launch did not expose a targetable window.
